steps.name: Jenna's Song (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Xena] in "Jisk Territory", defeat [Queen Aurora] in "Aurora Garden" and obtain <Secret Sheet Music>. Then return to “Jisk Territory” and report to [Xena].

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: To wipe away the flowing tears. The wind comes out and passes by you♪

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Goddess of the Earth. Please catch the passing wind♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I don’t know many songs, so I’m tired of singing them over and over… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I okay? I like Jenna because she sings so well.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I’m surprised!!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, how long have you been there? You thought it was a ghost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For a moment I thought I heard wrong.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Phew, my surprise has subsided a bit. Welcome, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to see if anything was going on.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you for watching... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thanks to you, I was able to meet and talk with my brother. From small things to the most recent, it's all thanks to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. But I guess this is what Jiscard brought?
(All kinds of food and gift boxes are placed around Jenna.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, those are the things I liked. Even though you can't eat it or touch it. still… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm glad that my feelings were conveyed.
(Jenna smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad it looks good. By the way, I guess you don’t like the song?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm tired of singing the same song for hundreds of years. I wanted to ask you a favor, but I'm so sorry that you're busy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. Something comes to mind... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like me to get you the sheet music? It reminded me of sheet music that someone had before.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah, good. If it's not difficult, you can watch and sing along!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not difficult to give, but what if there are multiple copies? I think it would be a bit difficult to get over it.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Don't worry. Over the years, I have become friends with a few well-behaved Algeas. I'll recruit those kids!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, there is a way. Then, I will get the sheet music and come back to the estate right away.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

steps.name: Jenna's Song (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Betrayal Aergia] at “Lake of Oblivion” and obtain <Tears of the Betrayed Spirit>. Then report to [Iris] in the dungeon ‘Frozen World’.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the score I was talking about. Would you like to take a moment?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes!
(Jenna looks at the score and concentrates.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah, this… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Beautiful serenade... I think it’s a song!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: La la la la la la ♪ La la la la la la ♪
(Jenna looks happy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this the song I heard? It definitely has the same melody as the song Queen Aurora sang...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: There is someone who sang this song. You must have had someone in mind... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Looks like it didn't go well. I feel sorry for you. I thought it would have done well if you had sung such a good song.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are times in the world when things don't go as planned.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Then I will sing a song. I modified the lyrics in the score a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Jenna takes a deep breath and begins to hum slowly. Her clear and beautiful voice spreads through the territory little by little.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My love♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The person I wanted to see so much♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Let's go back a long time and now hold hands... ♩
(You can almost see the animals in the territory stopping their actions and reacting to Jenna's voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… . I really like the song Jenna sings.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. I really wanted to tell Adventurer. If your brother comes too, I'll let you know... . Oh, I'd like to tell Gaia and Iris too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure about Gaia, but it might be possible for Iris. Oh, but Jenna can't leave this place.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Maybe that will help, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is a story I heard from my mother when I was alive. no… . Although it may not be exactly when I was alive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you still care? After all, those are Jenna’s memories.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That said… . Anyway, thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Anyway! That's what the story is! It is said that since ancient times, spirit tears have been used as a tool to capture certain sounds and emotions.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm not sure how it works, but the spirits have heard my song, so all I have to do is cry... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since it belongs to a spirit that follows God, I think it will work out somehow. Then we have to find the spirits here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get it and bring it to Iris. Although it is not exactly the body of Iris.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I promise. And if I have any good sheet music later, I'll bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. really… . Then I'll ask you a favor.

steps.name: Jenna's Song (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in "The Frozen World" and go to [Minuet] in "Adrica".

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw Iris a while ago, but it still feels like it's been a long time since I came to see the frozen world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you for always believing in me and waiting for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know Iris believes in me. So thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't think about anything, just think about the day this will end for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still a lot of thoughts in me that haven't been organized.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I found out about Iris, came here, went through a lot..., and...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you okay with what happened back then? I saw it at the estate... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. I was a little surprised at first, but I accepted it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank goodness. Oh, I almost forgot. Jenna had a favor to ask... .
(I briefly explain to Iris that I came at Jenna’s request.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then will you give me the spirit tears?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. here… .
(Iris stretches out its hand toward the air, receiving the spirit's tears. The spirit's tears rise to the sky on the wind and flow down like rain.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This will make Xena's voice come out of the frozen world. While descending, you can hear a beautiful voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like Iris said, Jenna's voice is falling.)

lines.speaker: 제나의 목소리
lines.text: My love♬

lines.speaker: 제나의 목소리
lines.text: The person I wanted to see so much♬
(Iris closes her eyes and listens to Jenna's voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris, are you crying? Oh, is it rain?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna's voice is amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, why?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please share this song with Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I meet Gaia?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay to say Gaia, but I think you can just talk to Minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. Okay, Iris. thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, then take care.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet! minuet!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, it's a minuet! You only need to call once.  What brought you here... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you! It's a good song!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't said a word yet... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was able to understand right away because you talked to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is what Iris meant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a song that Jiscard's younger sister, Jenna, wanted to sing to Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This means that your ears are strong.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: %s heard this song right in front of you. i envy you… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I also want to hear that song in front of someone named Jenna. However, they are tied to the territory of Adrica and Jisk... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If Gaia listens, I'll be fine too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I have a new score, I'll take it to Jenna and continue to find the minuet in the same way as today.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh?
(It's subtle, but Minuet's expression seems to have changed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't know, but come this way when the time comes. Not right away, but I think you should come here.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adkina and Mediah will soon release the seal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (On the way to Phobos….)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: So please wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'm good at waiting.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: See you later then. I think I need to sleep for a bit. Gaia also told Minuet to sleep for about six hours a day whenever he gets the chance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, minuet. good night.
(The minuet is asleep while standing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because you resemble Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sleepy too. Should I go to nearby Tartarus and sleep? . Haam… .
